svg.title: Waterline bounded-authority architecture
svg.desc: A left-to-right view of authenticated intake, the Gemini and ADK agent fleet, deterministic authority, and the observable flight-following consequence. Agents read and propose; policy and the authenticated pilot authorize.
svg.text: Agents assemble the briefing. The pilot and policy keep the key.
One station-less route · one bounded fleet · one authenticated attestation · one duplicate-safe handoff

g.text: ONLY ROUTE FIELDS CROSS THE EDGE

g.text: Gemini extracts, ranks, composes, and proposes.
